user.title: Choose how to reach Google Translate
user.description: Without an account, the same free service that translate.google.com uses works out of the box. For heavy or business use, an API key for the Cloud Translation API is the reliable choice.

web.title: Google Translate without an account
web.description: This uses the keyless endpoint behind translate.google.com. It is free, but unofficial: Google may limit or change it at any time, so it suits occasional translations. Select Submit to test it.

cloud.title: Cloud Translation API
cloud.description: Create an API key under APIs & Services > Credentials in the Google Cloud console and enable the Cloud Translation API for the project. The first 500,000 characters per month are free, but Google requires a billing account.

data_description.monthly_character_limit: Translations that would exceed this many characters in a month are refused before anything is sent. Use 0 for no limit. The Cloud API is free up to 500,000 characters per month.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Google again
reauth_confirm.description: Google no longer accepts the API key of {account}. Enter a new one.

discovery_confirm.title: Set up Google Translator
discovery_confirm.description: Google Translator was found on this Home Assistant server. Select Submit to choose how to reach Google Translate. Without an account, the translation actions are not available.

error.invalid_auth: Google rejected the API key. Check the key and that the Cloud Translation API is enabled for its project.
error.cannot_connect: Google could not be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.rate_limited: Google is limiting requests right now. Wait a few minutes or use an API key.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Google account is already set up.
abort.not_local_instance: This Home Assistant advertisement belongs to another server.
abort.invalid_yaml: The YAML configuration is invalid. Check the options in configuration.yaml.

init.title: Google Translator options
init.description: Changes are applied when the account reloads. Values set in configuration.yaml are applied again at every start.

data_description.discover_translator: Suggest setting up the optional Custom Integration Translator when it is installed.
data_description.monthly_character_limit: Translations that would exceed this many characters in a month are refused before anything is sent. Use 0 for no limit. The Cloud API is free up to 500,000 characters per month.
data_description.cache_size: Number of translations kept in memory. 0 turns the cache off.

translate_text.name: Translate text
translate_text.description: Translates one or more texts with Google Translate and returns the result.

text.name: Text
text.description: The text to translate. Use a list to translate several texts in one request.

target_language.name: Target language
target_language.description: Language to translate into. Defaults to the one chosen for the integration.

source_language.name: Source language
source_language.description: Language of the text. Leave empty to let Google detect it.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The Google account to use. Only needed when several are set up.

translate_structure.name: Translate structure
translate_structure.description: Translates only the text values of JSON or YAML data and keeps its structure. Files keep their exact layout, including indentation, key order, quoting and comments; keys are never translated.

data.name: Data
data.description: Structured data to translate. Use this or an input file.

input_file.name: Input file
input_file.description: A JSON or YAML file to translate. Relative paths start in the configuration folder.

output_file.name: Output file
output_file.description: Where to store the translated file. Defaults to the input name with the target language added, for example en.de.json.

format.name: Format
format.description: File format. Auto guesses it from the file extension.

only_keys.name: Only keys
only_keys.description: Translate only values that belong to these keys, for example name, title and message. Recommended for configuration files, where most values are technical.

ignore_keys.name: Ignore keys
ignore_keys.description: Never translate values that belong to these keys.

skip_technical_values.name: Skip technical values
skip_technical_values.description: Leave URLs, entity IDs, icons, colors, version numbers and similar identifiers alone.

protect_placeholders.name: Protect placeholders
protect_placeholders.description: Keep placeholders such as {name}, %s and {{ template }} unchanged.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: List the texts that would be translated and count their characters, without contacting Google.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Only JSON files can be replaced; an existing YAML file is never overwritten.

target_language.name: Target language
target_language.description: Language to translate into. Defaults to the one chosen for the integration.

source_language.name: Source language
source_language.description: Language of the text. Leave empty to let Google detect it.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The Google account to use. Only needed when several are set up.

get_languages.name: Get languages
get_languages.description: Lists the languages Google Translate supports.

type.name: Type
type.description: Google offers the same languages as source and target.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The Google account to use. Only needed when several are set up.

get_usage.name: Get usage
get_usage.description: Returns the characters counted this month and what is left of the monthly limit. Google reports no usage itself, so the figures are counted by this integration.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Start a new counting period if the month has changed before answering.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The Google account to use. Only needed when several are set up.
